description: This Java test class, InsertWithUuidDataChangeDatabaseIT, tests database interactions related to inserting data with UUIDs in the OpenMRS project, specifically verifying that UUIDs are correctly generated and stored in the 'name_with_uuid' table.

classes.name: InsertWithUuidDataChangeDatabaseIT
classes.description: A JUnit 5 integration test class extending DatabaseIT to verify UUID insertion logic.

methods.name: shouldInsertUuids
methods.description: Executes the test to verify UUIDs are inserted correctly into the database, and that the UUID for 'charlie' is valid.

methods.name: getNamesWithUuids
methods.description: Retrieves all name-UUID pairs from the 'name_with_uuid' table for validation.
